 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd):

 */

        ethernet {

## evo/chassis/redundancy-re0-primary-re1-backup-failover-graceful-switchover.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: Routing Engine redundancy: RE0 primary and RE1 backup, failover on loss of keepalives or disk failure, and graceful switchover
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   total 6
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables: none
 */
chassis {
    redundancy {
        routing-engine 0 master;
        routing-engine 1 backup;
        failover {
            on-loss-of-keepalives;
            on-disk-failure;
        }
        graceful-switchover;
    }
}
```

## evo/firewall/filter-cpp-filter-v1-tcp-8080.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: cpp-filter-v1: the loopback control-plane protection filter, with an additional term that accepts TCP port 8080
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine1_qfx5220-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine2_qfx5220-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine1_qfx5230-64cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine2_qfx5230-64cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine1_qfx5220-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine2_qfx5220-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine1_qfx5230-64cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine2_qfx5230-64cd 1
 *   total 8
 * Pair with:
 *  - evo/firewall/policer-police-5mbps.conf
 *
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c):
 *   $TERM_NAME_1   e.g. ssh
 *   $TERM_NAME_2   e.g. icmp
 *   $TERM_NAME_3   e.g. bgp
 *   $TERM_NAME_4   e.g. dns
 *   $TERM_NAME_5   e.g. ntp
 *   $TERM_NAME_6   e.g. dhcp
 *   $TERM_NAME_7   e.g. netconf
 *   $TERM_NAME_8   e.g. bfd
 *   $TERM_NAME_9   e.g. snmp
 *   $TERM_NAME_10  e.g. ospf
 *   $TERM_NAME_11  e.g. fetch
 *   $TERM_NAME_12  e.g. discard-rest
 */
firewall {
    filter cpp-filter-v1 {
        term $TERM_NAME_1 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ssh-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port ssh;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-ssh-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_2 {
            from {
                protocol icmp;
                icmp-type [ echo-request echo-reply unreachable time-exceeded ];
            }
            then {
                policer police-5mbps;
                count cpp-icmp-accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_3 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    bgp-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port bgp;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_4 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                source-port 53;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-dns-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_5 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ntp-sources;
                }
                protocol udp;
                port ntp;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-ntp-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_6 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                port dhcp;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-dhcp-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_7 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ssh-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port 830;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-netconf-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_8 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                port [ 1280 3784 4784 3785 ];
            }
            then {
                count cpp-bfd-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_9 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    snmp-sources;
                }
                port snmp;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_10 {
            from {
                protocol ospf;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_11 {
            from {
                protocol tcp;
                port 8080;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_12 {
            then {
                count cpp-discard-rest;
                discard;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Needs (MANIFEST.json occurrence_requires; same OS):
- `policer` (`police-5mbps`): required, for each reference; `firewall/policer-police-5mbps`

## evo/firewall/policer-police-5mbps.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: police-5mbps: a 5-Mbps policer that discards excess traffic
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine1_qfx5220-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine2_qfx5220-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine1_qfx5230-64cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine2_qfx5230-64cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine1_qfx5220-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-spine2_qfx5220-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine1_qfx5230-64cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_superspine2_qfx5230-64cd 1
 *   total 8
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables: none
 */
firewall {
    policer police-5mbps {
        if-exceeding {
            bandwidth-limit 5m;
            burst-size-limit 5m;
        }
        then discard;
    }
}
```

## evo/interfaces/ifd-ae-esi-all-active-lacp-system-id.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: Aggregated Ethernet interface for an ESI-LAG: all-active Ethernet segment, active LACP with a fixed system ID and a 9216-byte MTU
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd):
 *   $AE_BUNDLE    e.g. ae1
 *   $DESCRIPTION  e.g. to.sys003-001-003
 *   $ESI          e.g. 00:08:00:00:00:00:03:00:00:03
 *   $LACP_SYS_ID  e.g. 08:00:00:00:00:03
 */
interfaces {
    $AE_BUNDLE {
        description $DESCRIPTION;
        mtu 9216;
        esi {
            $ESI;
            all-active;
        }
        aggregated-ether-options {
            lacp {
                active;
                system-id $LACP_SYS_ID;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Needs (MANIFEST.json occurrence_requires; same OS):
- `lag-member`: when the router's configuration has it, all related; `interfaces/ifd-core-lag-member-ether-description`

 *   $AC_INTF     e.g. ae1

 *   $BD_NAME_3   e.g. vn2502
 *   $BD_NAME_4   e.g. vn2503
 *   $BD_NAME_5   e.g. vn2504
 *   $BD_NAME_6   e.g. vn2505
 *   $BD_NAME_7   e.g. vn2506
 *   $BD_NAME_8   e.g. vn2507
 *   $BD_NAME_9   e.g. vn2508

 *

 *   $TERM_NAME_4          e.g. EVPN_GW_IN-40

 *   $TERM_NAME_5          e.g. EVPN_GW_IN-45

                family evpn;
                community EVPN_DCI_L2_TARGET;

                community add $COMMUNITY_NAME;

                family evpn;
                community EVPN_DCI_L3_TARGET_blue;

            }
            then {
                community add $COMMUNITY_NAME;
                accept;
            }

                family evpn;
                community EVPN_DCI_L3_TARGET_red;

            }

                family evpn;

        }
    }
}

## evo/protocols/bgp-group-ebgp-dci-link-1-peer-multihop-bfd-import-export.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: eBGP group in the default instance toward the remote data center's DCI gateway over the DCI link (Apstra's external-router connection): one IPv4 peer over multihop, BFD, an import and an export policy
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf1_qfx5700 dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf2_qfx5700 dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf1_qfx5700 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf2_qfx5700 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c 1
 *   total 10
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with:
 *   [dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf1_qfx5700]
 *   [dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf2_qfx5700]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf1_qfx5130-48c]
 *   [dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-leaf2_qfx5130-48c]
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd):
 *   $BGP_GROUP          e.g. l3rtr
 *   $DCI_LINK_PEER_V4   e.g. 172.17.10.2
 *   $DESCRIPTION        e.g. facing_bl1-dci-link1
 *   $MULTIHOP_TTL       e.g. 2
 *   $DCI_LINK_LOCAL_V4  e.g. 172.17.10.1
 *   $BGP_IMPORT_POL     e.g. RoutesFromExt-default-DCI1
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL     e.g. RoutesToExt-default-DCI1
 *   $ASN_DCI_PEER       e.g. 65105
 */
protocols {
    bgp {
        group $BGP_GROUP {
            type external;
            multihop {
                ttl 1;
            }
            family inet {
                unicast {
                    loops 2;
                }
            }
            family inet6 {
                unicast {
                    loops 2;
                }
            }
            multipath {
                multiple-as;
            }
            neighbor $DCI_LINK_PEER_V4 {
                description $DESCRIPTION;
                multihop {
                    ttl $MULTIHOP_TTL;
                }
                local-address $DCI_LINK_LOCAL_V4;
                import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                peer-as $ASN_DCI_PEER;
                bfd-liveness-detection {
                    minimum-interval 1000;
                    multiplier 3;
                }
            }
            vpn-apply-export;
        }
    }
}

                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_2;
            }
            neighbor $UNDERLAY_PEER_V4_5 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_5;
                local-address $UNDERLAY_LOCAL_V4_5;
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_3;
            }
            neighbor $UNDERLAY_PEER_V4_6 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_6;
                local-address $UNDERLAY_LOCAL_V4_6;
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_3;
            }
            vpn-apply-export;
        }
    }
}
```

Needs (MANIFEST.json occurrence_requires; same OS):
- `policy-statement` (`$BGP_EXPORT_POL_1`, `$BGP_EXPORT_POL_2`): required, for each reference; one of `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-add-from-superspine-tier-accept`, `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-from-policy-bgp-accept-reject`

/*
 * Topic: EVPN Type 5 VRF with ten IRB units and a loopback unit
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_storage-leaf1_qfx5130-32cd):
 *   $INSTANCE_NAME         e.g. green
 *   $VNI                   e.g. 20004
 *   $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL  e.g. BGP-AOS-Policy-green
 *   $IRB_IFL_1             e.g. irb.2500
 *   $IRB_IFL_2             e.g. irb.2501
 *   $IRB_IFL_3             e.g. irb.2502
 *   $IRB_IFL_4             e.g. irb.2503
 *   $IRB_IFL_5             e.g. irb.2504
 *   $IRB_IFL_6             e.g. irb.2505
 *   $IRB_IFL_7             e.g. irb.2506

 *   $LOOPBACK_V4           e.g. 192.168.252.10

routing-instances {
    $INSTANCE_NAME {
        instance-type vrf;
        routing-options {
            rib $INSTANCE_NAME.inet6.0 {
                multipath;
            }
            graceful-restart;
            multipath;
            auto-export;
        }
        protocols {
            evpn {
                ip-prefix-routes {
                    advertise direct-nexthop;
                    encapsulation vxlan;
                    vni $VNI;
                    export $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL;
                }

 *   $DESCRIPTION           e.g. facing_dc1-borderleaf-001-sys001
 *   $PE_LOCAL_V6           e.g. 2001:db8:dc1:10:200::4
 *   $BGP_IMPORT_POL        e.g. RoutesFromExt-blue-external_router
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL        e.g. RoutesToExt-blue-external_router
 *   $ASN_CUSTOMER          e.g. 65000
 *   $CE_PEER_V4            e.g. 10.200.0.5
 *   $PE_LOCAL_V4           e.g. 10.200.0.4
 *   $VNI                   e.g. 20002
 *   $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL  e.g. BGP-AOS-Policy-blue
 *   $DHCP_RELAY_GROUP      e.g. blue
 *   $AC_IFL                e.g. et-0/0/8:0.299
 *   $LOOPBACK_IFL          e.g. lo0.2
 *   $LOOPBACK_V4           e.g. 192.168.255.2
 */
routing-instances {
    $INSTANCE_NAME {
        instance-type vrf;
        routing-options {
            rib $INSTANCE_NAME.inet6.0 {
                multipath;
            }
            graceful-restart;
            multipath;
            auto-export;
        }
        protocols {
            bgp {
                group $BGP_GROUP {
                    type external;
                    multihop {
                        ttl 1;
                    }
                    family inet {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    family inet6 {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    multipath {
                        multiple-as;
                    }
                    neighbor $CE_PEER_V6 {
                        description $DESCRIPTION;
                        multihop {
                            ttl 2;
                        }
                        local-address $PE_LOCAL_V6;
                        import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                        family inet6 {
                            unicast;
                        }
                        export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                        peer-as $ASN_CUSTOMER;

                        multihop {

                        local-address $PE_LOCAL_V4;

                            unicast;
                        }
                        export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                        peer-as $ASN_CUSTOMER;
                    }
                }
                graceful-restart {
                    dont-help-shared-fate-bfd-down;
                }

                ip-prefix-routes {

                    vni $VNI;

                group $DHCP_RELAY_GROUP {
                    active-server-group blue;
                    relay-option-82 {
                        server-id-override;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        interface $AC_IFL;
        interface $LOOPBACK_IFL;
        route-distinguisher $LOOPBACK_V4:3;
        vrf-target target:20002:1;
    }
}

## evo/security/macsec-static-cak-gcm-aes-xpn-128-1-interface.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: MACsec on a DCI link: one connectivity association with a static CAK (pre-shared key name and key) and the GCM-AES-XPN-128 cipher suite, applied to one interface
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: (none)
 *   EVO: dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf1_qfx5700 dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf2_qfx5700 dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf1_qfx5700 1
 *   dc1-dc2_ott/dc2_borderleaf2_qfx5700 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   total 8
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd):
 *   $MACSEC_CA   e.g. dc1-dc2-dci
 *   $MACSEC_CKN  e.g. abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234
 *   $MACSEC_CAK  e.g. "<MACSEC_CAK>"
 *   $CORE_PHYS   e.g. et-0/0/12:2
 */
security {
    macsec {
        connectivity-association $MACSEC_CA {
            cipher-suite gcm-aes-xpn-128;
            security-mode static-cak;
            pre-shared-key {
                ckn $MACSEC_CKN;
                cak $MACSEC_CAK;
            }
        }
        interfaces {
            $CORE_PHYS {
                connectivity-association $MACSEC_CA;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_spine2_qfx5220-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc1_spine1_qfx5220-32cd 1

 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc2_ott/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd):
 *   $LOCAL_CERT  e.g. aos_grpc
 */
system {
    services {
        netconf {
            ssh;
        }
        ssh {
            root-login allow;
        }
        extension-service {
            request-response {
                grpc {
                    ssl {
                        port 32767;
                        local-certificate $LOCAL_CERT;
                    }
                    routing-instance mgmt_junos;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

```
/*
 * Topic: cpp-filter-v1: the loopback control-plane protection filter, with an additional term that accepts TCP port 8080
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf1_qfx5120-48ym dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine1_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine2_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine1_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine2_qfx5210-64c
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf1_qfx5120-48ym 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine1_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine2_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine1_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine2_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   total 6
 * Pair with:
 *  - junos/firewall/policer-police-5mbps.conf
 *
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf1_qfx5120-48ym):
 *   $TERM_NAME_1   e.g. ssh
 *   $TERM_NAME_2   e.g. icmp
 *   $TERM_NAME_3   e.g. bgp
 *   $TERM_NAME_4   e.g. dns
 *   $TERM_NAME_5   e.g. ntp
 *   $TERM_NAME_6   e.g. dhcp
 *   $TERM_NAME_7   e.g. netconf
 *   $TERM_NAME_8   e.g. bfd
 *   $TERM_NAME_9   e.g. snmp
 *   $TERM_NAME_10  e.g. ospf
 *   $TERM_NAME_11  e.g. fetch
 *   $TERM_NAME_12  e.g. discard-rest
 */
firewall {
    filter cpp-filter-v1 {
        term $TERM_NAME_1 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ssh-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port ssh;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-ssh-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_2 {
            from {
                protocol icmp;
                icmp-type [ echo-request echo-reply unreachable time-exceeded ];
            }
            then {
                policer police-5mbps;
                count cpp-icmp-accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_3 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    bgp-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port bgp;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_4 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                source-port 53;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-dns-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_5 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ntp-sources;
                }
                protocol udp;
                port ntp;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-ntp-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_6 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                port dhcp;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-dhcp-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_7 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    ssh-sources;
                }
                protocol tcp;
                port 830;
            }
            then {
                count cpp-netconf-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_8 {
            from {
                protocol udp;
                port [ 1280 3784 4784 3785 ];
            }
            then {
                count cpp-bfd-accept;
                accept;
            }
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_9 {
            from {
                source-prefix-list {
                    snmp-sources;
                }
                port snmp;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_10 {
            from {
                protocol ospf;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_11 {
            from {
                protocol tcp;
                port 8080;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_12 {
            then {
                count cpp-discard-rest;
                discard;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf1_qfx5120-48ym dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine1_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine2_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine1_qfx5210-64c dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine2_qfx5210-64c
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf1_qfx5120-48ym 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine1_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-spine2_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine1_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_services-spine2_qfx5210-64c 1
 *   total 6

 */

 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_leaf1_qfx5120-48y 2
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 2
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_leaf3_qfx5120-48y 2
 *   total 12
 * Pair with: none

 *   $IRB_MAC      e.g. 00:1c:73:00:00:01
 */
interfaces {
    irb {
        unit $IRB_UNIT {
            family inet {
                mtu 9000;
                address $IRB_ADDR;

            family inet6 {
                mtu 9000;
                address $IRB_ADDR_V6;
            }
            mac $IRB_MAC;
            no-dhcp-flood;
        }
    }
}

 *   $IRB_MAC      e.g. 00:1c:73:00:00:01
 */
interfaces {
    irb {
        unit $IRB_UNIT {
            family inet {
                mtu 9000;
                address $IRB_ADDR;
            }
            family inet6 {
                mtu 9000;
                address $IRB_ADDR_V6;
            }
            mac $IRB_MAC;
        }
    }
}
```

 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with:
 *  - junos/policy-options/community/cm-instance-target.conf
 *
 * Peers with: n/a
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL  e.g. LEAF_TO_LEAF_EVPN_OUT
 *   $TERM_NAME_1     e.g. LEAF_TO_LEAF_EVPN_OUT-10
 *   $TERM_NAME_2     e.g. LEAF_TO_LEAF_EVPN_OUT-20
 *   $TERM_NAME_3     e.g. LEAF_TO_LEAF_EVPN_OUT-30
 */
policy-options {
    policy-statement $BGP_EXPORT_POL {
        term $TERM_NAME_1 {
            from {
                protocol [ bgp evpn ];
                community FABRIC_EVI_TARGET;
            }
            then accept;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_2 {
            from {
                protocol [ bgp evpn ];
                community EVPN_DCI_L2_TARGET;
            }
            then reject;
        }
        term $TERM_NAME_3 {
            then accept;
        }
    }
}
```

## junos/protocols/bgp-group-ebgp-dci-link-1-peer-multihop-bfd-import-export.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: eBGP group in the default instance toward the remote data center's DCI gateway over the DCI link (Apstra's external-router connection): one IPv4 peer over multihop, BFD, an import and an export policy
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with:
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y]
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $BGP_GROUP          e.g. l3rtr
 *   $DCI_LINK_PEER_V4   e.g. 172.27.0.1
 *   $DESCRIPTION        e.g. facing_dc3-dc1-link1
 *   $MULTIHOP_TTL       e.g. 2
 *   $DCI_LINK_LOCAL_V4  e.g. 172.27.0.2
 *   $BGP_IMPORT_POL     e.g. RoutesFromExt-default-DC3-DCI
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL     e.g. RoutesToExt-default-DC3-DCI
 *   $ASN_DCI_PEER       e.g. 64514
 */
protocols {
    bgp {
        group $BGP_GROUP {
            type external;
            multihop {
                ttl 1;
            }
            family inet {
                unicast {
                    loops 2;
                }
            }
            family inet6 {
                unicast {
                    loops 2;
                }
            }
            multipath {
                multiple-as;
            }
            neighbor $DCI_LINK_PEER_V4 {
                description $DESCRIPTION;
                multihop {
                    ttl $MULTIHOP_TTL;
                }
                local-address $DCI_LINK_LOCAL_V4;
                import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                peer-as $ASN_DCI_PEER;
                bfd-liveness-detection {
                    minimum-interval 1000;
                    multiplier 3;
                }
            }
            vpn-apply-export;
        }
    }
}
```

Needs (MANIFEST.json occurrence_requires; same OS):
- `policy-statement` (`$BGP_IMPORT_POL`, `$BGP_EXPORT_POL`): required, for each reference; one of `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-route-filter-list-community-add-reject-inet`, `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-route-filter-list-inet-community-delete-next-hop-self-reject`

## junos/protocols/bgp-group-ebgp-evpn-dci-gateway-2-peers-multihop-import-export-2-policies.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: eBGP EVPN group toward the remote data center gateways: two loopback peers over multihop, an import policy and a two-policy export chain
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y

 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with:
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf1_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y]
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_borderleaf2_qfx5130-32cd] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y]
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $BGP_GROUP         e.g. evpn-gw
 *   $DCI_PEER_V4_1     e.g. 192.168.255.2
 *   $DESCRIPTION_1     e.g. facing_dc3-dc1-1-evpn-gateway
 *   $LOOPBACK_V4       e.g. 192.168.253.0
 *   $BGP_IMPORT_POL    e.g. EVPN_GW_IN
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1  e.g. EVPN_GW_OUT
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2  e.g. EVPN_EXPORT
 *   $ASN_DCI_PEER_1    e.g. 64514
 *   $DCI_PEER_V4_2     e.g. 192.168.255.3
 *   $DESCRIPTION_2     e.g. facing_dc3-dc1-2-evpn-gateway
 *   $ASN_DCI_PEER_2    e.g. 64515
 */
protocols {
    bgp {
        group $BGP_GROUP {
            type external;
            multihop {
                ttl 30;
                no-nexthop-change;
            }
            multipath {
                multiple-as;
            }
            neighbor $DCI_PEER_V4_1 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_1;
                multihop {
                    ttl 5;
                }
                local-address $LOOPBACK_V4;
                import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                family evpn {
                    signaling;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_DCI_PEER_1;
            }
            neighbor $DCI_PEER_V4_2 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_2;
                multihop {
                    ttl 5;
                }
                local-address $LOOPBACK_V4;
                import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                family evpn {
                    signaling;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_DCI_PEER_2;
            }
            vpn-apply-export;
        }
    }
}

/*
 * Topic: Leaf eBGP EVPN overlay group with one loopback peer, BFD and an export list of two policy expressions
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y
 *   EVO: (none)

 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Peers with:
 *   [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y] <-> [dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y]
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $BGP_GROUP         e.g. l3clos-l-evpn
 *   $OVERLAY_PEER_V4   e.g. 192.168.253.1

            type external;
            multihop {
                ttl 1;
                no-nexthop-change;

            family evpn {
                signaling {
                    loops 2;

            vpn-apply-export;

}

                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_2;
            }
            neighbor $UNDERLAY_PEER_V4_3 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_3;
                local-address $UNDERLAY_LOCAL_V4_3;
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_3;
            }
            neighbor $UNDERLAY_PEER_V4_4 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_4;
                local-address $UNDERLAY_LOCAL_V4_4;
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_4;
            }
            neighbor $UNDERLAY_PEER_V4_5 {
                description $DESCRIPTION_5;
                local-address $UNDERLAY_LOCAL_V4_5;
                family inet {
                    unicast;
                }
                export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL_1 && $BGP_EXPORT_POL_2 );
                peer-as $ASN_FABRIC_PEER_5;
            }
            vpn-apply-export;
        }
    }
}

 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc1_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):

 *   $VNI                   e.g. 20004
 *   $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL  e.g. BGP-AOS-Policy-green
 *   $IRB_IFL_1             e.g. irb.2700
 *   $IRB_IFL_2             e.g. irb.2701
 *   $IRB_IFL_3             e.g. irb.2702
 *   $IRB_IFL_4             e.g. irb.2703
 *   $IRB_IFL_5             e.g. irb.2704
 *   $IRB_IFL_6             e.g. irb.2705

 *   $LOOPBACK_V4           e.g. 192.168.255.6
 */
routing-instances {
    $INSTANCE_NAME {
        instance-type vrf;
        routing-options {
            rib $INSTANCE_NAME.inet6.0 {
                multipath;
            }
            graceful-restart;
            multipath;
            auto-export;
        }
        protocols {
            evpn {
                ip-prefix-routes {
                    advertise direct-nexthop;
                    encapsulation vxlan;
                    vni $VNI;
                    export $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL;
                }
            }
        }
        interface $IRB_IFL_1;
        interface $IRB_IFL_2;
        interface $IRB_IFL_3;

        interface $IRB_IFL_5;
        interface $IRB_IFL_6;

        interface $IRB_IFL_8;
        interface $IRB_IFL_9;
        interface $IRB_IFL_10;
        interface $LOOPBACK_IFL;
        route-distinguisher $LOOPBACK_V4:4;
        vrf-target target:20004:1;

}

```
/*
 * Topic: Border EVPN Type 5 VRF with eBGP (IPv4) to the external router, ten IRB units and a loopback unit (blue tenant)
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $INSTANCE_NAME         e.g. blue
 *   $BGP_GROUP             e.g. l3rtr
 *   $CE_PEER_V4            e.g. 10.200.2.5
 *   $DESCRIPTION           e.g. facing_dc3-rack-001-sys004
 *   $PE_LOCAL_V4           e.g. 10.200.2.4
 *   $BGP_IMPORT_POL        e.g. RoutesFromExt-blue-external_router
 *   $BGP_EXPORT_POL        e.g. RoutesToExt-blue-external_router
 *   $ASN_CUSTOMER          e.g. 65000
 *   $VNI                   e.g. 13200
 *   $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL  e.g. BGP-AOS-Policy-blue
 *   $AC_IFL                e.g. xe-0/0/10.299
 *   $IRB_IFL_1             e.g. irb.1400
 *   $IRB_IFL_2             e.g. irb.1401
 *   $IRB_IFL_3             e.g. irb.1402
 *   $IRB_IFL_4             e.g. irb.1403
 *   $IRB_IFL_5             e.g. irb.1404
 *   $IRB_IFL_6             e.g. irb.1405
 *   $IRB_IFL_7             e.g. irb.1406
 *   $IRB_IFL_8             e.g. irb.1407
 *   $IRB_IFL_9             e.g. irb.1408
 *   $IRB_IFL_10            e.g. irb.1409
 *   $LOOPBACK_IFL          e.g. lo0.3
 *   $LOOPBACK_V4           e.g. 192.168.253.0
 */
routing-instances {
    $INSTANCE_NAME {
        instance-type vrf;
        routing-options {
            rib $INSTANCE_NAME.inet6.0 {
                multipath;
            }
            graceful-restart;
            multipath;
            auto-export;
        }
        protocols {
            bgp {
                group $BGP_GROUP {
                    type external;
                    multihop {
                        ttl 1;
                    }
                    family inet {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    family inet6 {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    multipath {
                        multiple-as;
                    }
                    neighbor $CE_PEER_V4 {
                        description $DESCRIPTION;
                        multihop {
                            ttl 2;
                        }
                        local-address $PE_LOCAL_V4;
                        import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                        family inet {
                            unicast;
                        }
                        export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                        peer-as $ASN_CUSTOMER;
                    }
                }
                graceful-restart {
                    dont-help-shared-fate-bfd-down;
                }
            }
            evpn {
                ip-prefix-routes {
                    advertise direct-nexthop;
                    encapsulation vxlan;
                    vni $VNI;
                    export $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL;
                }
            }
        }
        interface $AC_IFL;
        interface $IRB_IFL_1;
        interface $IRB_IFL_2;
        interface $IRB_IFL_3;
        interface $IRB_IFL_4;
        interface $IRB_IFL_5;
        interface $IRB_IFL_6;
        interface $IRB_IFL_7;
        interface $IRB_IFL_8;
        interface $IRB_IFL_9;
        interface $IRB_IFL_10;
        interface $LOOPBACK_IFL;
        route-distinguisher $LOOPBACK_V4:3200;
        vrf-target target:13200:1;
    }
}
```

 *   $IRB_IFL_7             e.g. irb.406
 *   $IRB_IFL_8             e.g. irb.407
 *   $IRB_IFL_9             e.g. irb.408
 *   $IRB_IFL_10            e.g. irb.409
 *   $LOOPBACK_IFL          e.g. lo0.2
 *   $LOOPBACK_V4           e.g. 192.168.253.0
 */
routing-instances {
    $INSTANCE_NAME {
        instance-type vrf;
        routing-options {
            rib $INSTANCE_NAME.inet6.0 {
                multipath;
            }
            graceful-restart;
            multipath;
            auto-export;
        }
        protocols {
            bgp {
                group $BGP_GROUP {
                    type external;
                    multihop {
                        ttl 1;
                    }
                    family inet {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    family inet6 {
                        unicast {
                            loops 2;
                        }
                    }
                    multipath {
                        multiple-as;
                    }
                    neighbor $CE_PEER_V4 {
                        description $DESCRIPTION;
                        multihop {
                            ttl 2;
                        }
                        local-address $PE_LOCAL_V4;
                        import ( $BGP_IMPORT_POL );
                        family inet {
                            unicast;
                        }
                        export ( $BGP_EXPORT_POL );
                        peer-as $ASN_CUSTOMER;
                    }
                }
                graceful-restart {
                    dont-help-shared-fate-bfd-down;
                }
            }
            evpn {
                ip-prefix-routes {
                    advertise direct-nexthop;
                    encapsulation vxlan;
                    vni $VNI;
                    export $IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL;
                }
            }
        }
        interface $AC_IFL;
        interface $IRB_IFL_1;
        interface $IRB_IFL_2;
        interface $IRB_IFL_3;
        interface $IRB_IFL_4;
        interface $IRB_IFL_5;
        interface $IRB_IFL_6;
        interface $IRB_IFL_7;
        interface $IRB_IFL_8;
        interface $IRB_IFL_9;
        interface $IRB_IFL_10;
        interface $LOOPBACK_IFL;
        route-distinguisher $LOOPBACK_V4:3100;
        vrf-target target:13100:1;
    }
}
```

Needs (MANIFEST.json occurrence_requires; same OS):
- `irb-service`: required, all related; one of 18 providers listed in MANIFEST.json
- `logical-interface` (`$AC_IFL`, `$IRB_IFL_1`, `$IRB_IFL_2`, `$IRB_IFL_3`, `$IRB_IFL_4`, `$IRB_IFL_5`, `$IRB_IFL_6`, `$IRB_IFL_7`, `$IRB_IFL_8`, `$IRB_IFL_9`, `$IRB_IFL_10`, `$LOOPBACK_IFL`): required, for each reference; one of `interfaces/ifl-description-vlan-inet`, `interfaces/ifl-inet-inet6`, `interfaces/irb-inet-inet6-mtu-9000-mac`
- `policy-statement` (`$BGP_IMPORT_POL`, `$BGP_EXPORT_POL`, `$IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL`): required, for each reference; one of `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-from-policy-bgp-accept-reject`, `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-route-filter-list-community-add-reject-inet`, `policy-options/policy-statement/ps-route-filter-list-community-delete-reject-inet`

## junos/security/macsec-static-cak-gcm-aes-xpn-128-1-interface.conf

```
/*
 * Topic: MACsec on a DCI link: one connectivity association with a static CAK (pre-shared key name and key) and the GCM-AES-XPN-128 cipher suite, applied to one interface
 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf2_qfx5120-48y 1
 *   total 2
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc3_type2_seamless/dc3_leaf1_qfx5120-48y):
 *   $MACSEC_CA   e.g. dc1-dc3-dci
 *   $MACSEC_CKN  e.g. 1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd
 *   $MACSEC_CAK  e.g. "<MACSEC_CAK>"
 *   $CORE_PHYS   e.g. xe-0/0/12
 */
security {
    macsec {
        connectivity-association $MACSEC_CA {
            cipher-suite gcm-aes-xpn-128;
            security-mode static-cak;
            pre-shared-key {
                ckn $MACSEC_CKN;
                cak $MACSEC_CAK;
            }
        }
        interfaces {
            $CORE_PHYS {
                connectivity-association $MACSEC_CA;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

/*

 * Seen on:
 *   Junos: dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym
 *   EVO: (none)
 * Count:
 *   dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym 1
 *   total 1
 * Pair with: none
 * Variables (example values from dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless/dc4_compute-leaf2_qfx5120-48ym):
 *   $GRPC_PORT   e.g. 32767
 *   $LOCAL_CERT  e.g. aos_grpc
 */
system {
    services {
        netconf {
            ssh;
        }
        extension-service {
            request-response {
                grpc {
                    ssl {
                        port $GRPC_PORT;
                        local-certificate $LOCAL_CERT;
                    }
                    routing-instance mgmt_junos;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

## _variables.md

# Snippet variable glossary

All `.conf` files under `junos/` and `evo/` are templates: identifiers that vary between deployments are written
as `$VAR`. Render a snippet by substituting each placeholder with your deployment's value. The placeholders each
snippet uses are listed in its `Variables:` header and in the glossary below. Variable names and meanings follow
the shared JVD snippet vocabulary. Numbered variables (`_1`, `_2`, …) form an ordered set; the numbers carry no
other meaning.

Values left literal on purpose: the tier communities `FROM_SPINE_FABRIC_TIER`, `FROM_SPINE_EVPN_TIER`,
`FROM_SUPERSPINE_FABRIC_TIER`, `FROM_SUPERSPINE_EVPN_TIER` and `FABRIC_COMMUNITIES` and the communities
`EVPN_GW_OUT` and `NO_ADVERTISE`, which the policies reference by name; the route targets (`vrf-target`) of the
MAC-VRFs, the VRFs and the EVPN interconnects, which each form carries as validated; the tenant prefixes in the
route-filter lists; the Routing Engine protection objects (filter `cpp-filter-v1`, policer `police-5mbps` and the
prefix lists `bgp-sources`, `ntp-sources`, `snmp-sources` and `ssh-sources`); the MTUs, the BFD timers, the port
speeds, the prefix-length ranges, the router-advertisement settings, the load-balancing parameters, the
management instance `mgmt_junos`, `unit 0`, and the loopback `lo0`.

## System

| Variable | What it is | Example value |
|---|---|---|
| `$FPC_SLOT` | FPC slot number. | `0` |
| `$GRPC_PORT` | TCP port of the gRPC request-response extension service over SSL. | `32767` |
| `$HOST_NAME` | System host name. | `dc1-borderleaf-001-leaf1` |
| `$LOCAL_CERT` | Name of a local certificate (`security certificates local`), as defined and as referenced by `local-certificate`. | `aos_grpc` |
| `$LOCAL_CERT_KEY` | PEM private key and certificate of a local certificate; secret, supplied by the operator. | `"<LOCAL_CERT_KEY>"` |
| `$PIC_PORT` | **new** Port number on a PIC whose speed a chassis statement sets (`chassis fpc <n> pic <n> port <n>`). | `51` |

## Identity / topology

| Variable | What it is | Example value |
|---|---|---|
| `$ASN` | Local device autonomous-system number. | `64514` |
| `$LOOPBACK_V4` | Primary per-node IPv4 loopback address. | `192.168.255.2` |

## Data center interconnect

| Variable | What it is | Example value |
|---|---|---|
| `$ASN_DCI_PEER` | **new** AS number of the remote site's DCI gateway, for both the overlay and the link sessions. | `65105` |
| `$ASN_DCI_PEER_1` | **new** AS number of the remote site's DCI gateway, for both the overlay and the link sessions. Numbered `_1`, `_2`, … in source order. | `64800` |
| `$ASN_DCI_PEER_2` | **new** AS number of the remote site's DCI gateway, for both the overlay and the link sessions. Numbered `_1`, `_2`, … in source order. | `64801` |
| `$DCI_LINK_LOCAL_V4` | **new** `local-address` of this gateway on the inter-site link. | `172.17.10.1` |
| `$DCI_LINK_PEER_V4` | **new** IPv4 address of the remote site's DCI gateway on the inter-site link (default-instance eBGP neighbor). | `172.17.10.2` |
| `$DCI_PEER_V4` | **new** Loopback IPv4 address of a remote DCI gateway: the neighbor of the multihop DCI overlay eBGP session between the gateways of two data centers. | `192.168.254.2` |
| `$DCI_PEER_V4_1` | **new** Loopback IPv4 address of a remote DCI gateway: the neighbor of the multihop DCI overlay eBGP session between the gateways of two data centers. Numbered `_1`, `_2`, … in source order. | `192.168.253.0` |

| Variable | What it is | Example value |
|---|---|---|
| `$ASN_CUSTOMER` | Customer-facing BGP peer autonomous-system number. | `65000` |
| `$CE_PEER_V4` | IPv4 address of a VRF eBGP neighbor on the customer or external side. | `10.200.0.5` |
| `$CE_PEER_V6` | IPv6 address of a VRF eBGP neighbor on the customer or external side. | `2001:db8:dc1:10:200::5` |
| `$DHCP_RELAY_GROUP` | Name of a DHCP relay group (`forwarding-options dhcp-relay group`); its interfaces relay DHCP to the server group. | `blue` |
| `$DHCP_SERVER_V4` | **new** IPv4 address of a DHCP server in a DHCP relay server group (`forwarding-options dhcp-relay server-group`). | `192.168.36.100` |
| `$INSTANCE_NAME` | Identity stem of a service instance. | `EVPN_DCI_L2_TARGET` |
| `$IP_PREFIX_EXPORT_POL` | Name of the policy-statement a routing instance exports as EVPN Type 5 IP prefix routes (`ip-prefix-routes export`), as applied and as defined. | `BGP-AOS-Policy-blue` |
| `$LOOPBACK_IFL` | Loopback logical interface (`lo0.<unit>`) listed in a routing instance. | `lo0.4` |
| `$PE_LOCAL_V4` | Local IPv4 address (`local-address`) of a VRF eBGP session toward the customer or external side. | `10.200.0.4` |
| `$PE_LOCAL_V6` | Local IPv6 address of the PE side of a CE eBGP session (`local-address`). | `2001:db8:dc1:10:200::4` |
| `$RT_AS` | Route Target Administrator subfield. | `65655L` |
| `$RT_ID` | Route Target Assigned Number subfield. | `1` |

Use them when the user picks a scenario, device and service and asks for lab values; otherwise ask for the deployment values. The DC1 hosts are captured once per scenario that uses them; their values do not change between scenarios, but a DC1 leaf's hostname does.

A MAC-VRF or Type 5 VRF uses the same instance name, VNIs and route targets on every device of the data center that carries it; an EVPN interconnect uses the same interconnect route target on the DCI gateways of both data centers; route distinguishers start with each device's own loopback.

## byoai/OUTPUT_FORMAT.md

# Output Format

This file is part of the [BYOAI](README.md) corpus. It defines the exact shape every generation must take. Bundled into `jvd-evpn-dci-snips.md` by `regenerate-bundle.sh`.

## 1. `Inputs used:` block (always first)

Every generation begins with a YAML comment block listing **every** value picked or accepted:

```yaml
# Inputs used:
# mode: auto                   # or "interview"
# form: minimum
# scenario: <dc1-dc2_ott|dc1-dc3_type2_seamless|dc1-dc4_type2_type5_seamless>
# devices:
#   dc1_leaf1: { name: <hostname>, os: junos, loopback4: <addr> }
#   dc1_borderleaf1: { name: <hostname>, os: evo, loopback4: <addr> }
# services:
#   - { kind: <evpn-mac-vrf-10-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-20-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-30-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-40-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-50-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-interconnect-20-vlans|evpn-mac-vrf-interconnect-50-vlans|evpn-type5-vrf-10-irb|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-20-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-20-irb-red|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-overrides-10-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-overrides-10-irb-red|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-overrides-20-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-dhcp-relay-overrides-20-irb-red|evpn-type5-vrf-interconnect-10-irb|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-dhcp-relay-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-dhcp-relay-overrides-10-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-dhcp-relay-overrides-10-irb-red|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-dhcp-relay-red|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-inet-10-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-inet-10-irb-red|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-interconnect-dhcp-relay-20-irb-blue|evpn-type5-vrf-ebgp-interconnect-dhcp-relay-20-irb-red>,
#       count: <int>,
#       start_id: <int>,
#       ac_ifl: <ifd.unit>,
#       rt: <rt_as:rt_id>,
#       rd: <admin:assigned> }
# snips_used:
#   - evo/routing-instances/l3vpn/ri-vrf-evpn-type-5-10-irb.conf
#   - ...
```

This block makes every generation reproducible — the user can paste it back to regenerate the same output.

## 2. One fenced `text` block per device

Each device block starts with a `# device:` label and groups its snips with `/* snips/<path> */` section comments:

```text
# device: <hostname>
/* snips/<path-to-snip>.conf */
<rendered config block>

/* snips/<path-to-next-snip>.conf */
<rendered config block>
```

Drop the leading C-style `/* … */` documentation header from each snip when emitting. Keep one `/* snips/<path> */` line as the section comment.

## 3. `Notes:` section (always last)

Bullets covering:

- The prerequisites the device must already run: the snip's `Pair with:` entries, the applicable entries of its Needs list and the requirements TIERS.md lists under the Blocked entry for that device. Name them; do not render them.
- Inputs defaulted because the user did not provide them.
- Cross-device consistency the user must verify: a MAC-VRF or Type 5 VRF uses the same instance name, VNIs and route targets on every device of the data center that carries it; each device's route distinguishers start with its own loopback; an EVPN interconnect uses the same interconnect route target on the DCI gateways of both data centers; the IRB units a VRF lists must exist in the device's MAC-VRF VLANs, and the VRF loopback unit must exist on the device.
- Anything that is by-pattern rather than validated on that exact device.

## Refusal

If the request cannot be fulfilled from the snip library, do not apologise. Say exactly:

```
I cannot generate this from the snip library because <one reason>.
```

…and stop.
